headSubject: feat(relay): Use a browser AI -- pick the chat AI, and send a long text as a file (F3 T3.5, Manager 0.13.33)
summary: F3 T3.5 landed (f43fc0f8, Manager 0.13.33): step 2 has one button per chat AI from the CLI's NPDevCli/relay-targets.json (npdev ai relay targets; eight, Google AI Mode separate from Gemini, all calibrated:false placeholders). A button opens that AI's https address and 'npdev ai relay target --code --target' records the choice and returns whether the prompt fits (only google-ai-mode, 8000 chars, is too small for the ~19k prompt). Too long -> 'Save as a file to attach': 'prompt --as attachment' writes into the conversation's folder (never Downloads), Rust relay_prompt_attachment reveals it, the short line (attachmentMessage in relay-prompts.json) goes on the clipboard, round marked delivery=attachment, screen goes to step 3. A picked-up conversation (T3.4) marks the AI it went to. F3 is now code-complete; what is left of it is owner-only (calibration, pilot). Verified: 17 new CLI tests, whole NPDevCli suite 1556 OK, render check 343/343, i18n 400/0, css tokens, version bump, portable-tooling scan, cargo check --tests 0 warnings, REAL window tour f3-t35/tour.mjs 13/13. The tour's first run had a mistake in the tour itself (open_url interception never active -> two real browser tabs opened); fixed and recorded in memory.
nextStep: F3 is code-complete, so there is no engineering NEXT inside it. Also decide whether to close the two tour leftovers still open in the real session store (PTXR, 6BG2; Home offers them): npdev ai relay abort --code X.
